title: tell me about your favorite places
content: I'm curious what dreamplaces mean the most to you and if mine are familiar to anyone. \- Large night time marketplace with sections based on various European countries \- A street with many retail shops, but all of the shops are massive, bigger than any in real life. If you go into a specific one, you can climb behind the clothing display and end up in a dark hotel with a large fountain or aquarium in the middle. \- An L-shaped diner restaurant at a rest stop off a high way, behind a green hill, with the ocean behind it (my favorite) \- Dream-Las Vegas - an uncanny valley version of Las Vegas \- Outdoor market place with many white buildings and lots of blue pools in between them. Almost Greece-like but all on flat ground. Extremely calming place. Also why do I always get searched so hard at the weird airport? I'm always about to miss my flight to who knows where. Can't wait to hear yours! Any drawings or AI generations welcome too.
